title: AES S-box Boolean circuit: minimize total gates and multiplicative complexity
description: Sunstead pins AWS Automated Reasoning's verbatim NIST FIPS 197 AES S-box table (`SBOX` from `leanprover/LNSym@49f8a1d9`, Apache-2.0) and kernel-proves byte-for-byte agreement with the algebraic GF(2^8) formula on all 256 inputs in pure Lean 4.36.0 (no Mathlib). Two independent hill-climb tracks challenge contributors to minimize straight-line `{xor, xnor, and, not}` circuits computing the AES S-box: total gate count (seeded at 130 gates from a normal-basis GF(((2^2)^2)^2) tower-field decomposition) and multiplicative complexity / AND gate count (seeded at 36 AND gates).

tasks.title: Minimize total gate count over {xor, xnor, and, not}
tasks.description: Submit a straight-line circuit in AesSbox/TotalCircuit.lean (`totalScore`, `totalGates`, `totalOutputs`). The frozen Lean 4 kernel proof verifies well-formedness, gate count, and exact equivalence to the NIST FIPS 197 AES S-box on all 256 inputs via `decide +kernel`. Only strict improvements below the current record earn credit.

tasks.title: Minimize multiplicative complexity (AND gate count)
tasks.description: Submit a straight-line circuit in AesSbox/AndCircuit.lean (`andScore`, `andGates`, `andOutputs`). The frozen Lean 4 kernel proof verifies well-formedness, AND gate count (`op == 2`), and exact equivalence to the NIST FIPS 197 AES S-box on all 256 inputs via `decide +kernel`. Only strict improvements below the current record earn credit.
